author: PokerFace
body: So, I understand this is the very first "Avicus" tournament and there were many different posts on small segments. It's kind of confusing so, if there can just be 1 post with all the information since everything is pretty much finalized, that would be great. This would mean that once this post is made, all the others should be archived since it will be on the "final post". How I see it is that there should be 1 tournament information post per tournament. Just to help with unnecessary clutter in the Event Information Post. The power is in your hands so please don't disregard this. Thanks.
